description: Encode the five phase-1 fields (plus optional phase-2 hash/signature/key tags) into the base64 TLV string that goes into the QR image and the UBL QR reference. Free. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.
